decision: Independent comparison found no required English fidelity or readability revision in the bound current base lesson. This is text approval only, not native, display, pixel, retention, accessibility or publication approval.

scope.comparisonBasis: Approved CURRENT modern-us-neutral Chinese lesson, exercises and figure manifest; not an uncorrected historical source snapshot.
reviewed: Current title, printed title, chapter and section metadata
All eight current prose objects, including every segment of the twelve final flow paragraphs
Both written solved-example prompts, complete solutions and all concluding qualifications
Conditions, unit words, constants, ordered math tokens, equation numbers and figure references
Native HTML caption text and figure identity as local text, without browser or image viewing
outOfScope: Re-review of approved Chinese source transcription or scientific amendments
Opening source scans, SVGs, artwork or screenshots; fresh geometry or pixel certification
Native pipeline reruns, browser display, mobile recovery, retention, DB or publication
Complete English accessibility or localization of source-identity metadata

method.semanticReview: Read the actual Chinese and English current texts side by side. Author statements and native status did not decide the linguistic outcome.
method.mechanicalSupport: Read-only Node checks independently confirmed ordered dollar-delimited math equality, ordered numeral equality, source_text and source snapshot equality, full erratum equality, and figure-manifest entry equality. SHA-256 and byte sizes were recomputed from inspected local files.
method.authorToCurrent: All eight prose texts equal the author template after whitespace normalization. Current exercises and figures are byte-identical to the author's respective templates. Final English flow and anchors were assessed from current text and the bound native flow artifact.
method.receiptBindings: All three approved Chinese input bindings and all three current English content bindings match the prepared/native receipts; prepared, author and both native HTML bindings also match.
method.unitBindingConvention: sourceBinding/currentBinding resolve into bindings below; pointers address the actual JSON file. Flow indices are zero-based native paragraph indices.

units.fidelity: Energy of the Electric Field faithfully translates the title. Printed title keeps 84. Part Two: Fundamentals of Electrodynamics and Chapter Eight: Electrostatics preserve the source hierarchy and subject identities.
units.readability: Clear conventional English headings; no invented explanatory claim.
units.identity: Card IDs, number 84, source pages 206/197, figure 160 and exercise count 2 are retained. The reference prose still describes section as unchanged, while the supplied native/author carrier translates it; this documentary drift is reported, not edited.

units.fidelity: Retains stationary charged bodies, local-interaction description, electrostatic interaction energy rather than all body energy, reversible dielectric polarization and the appropriate-model qualification.
units.readability: Local interactions, reversible polarization and field strength are intelligible and consistently used. Read across the native paragraph split after the semicolon: the following 'it is not' completes the same qualification, with no omission or new scope.

units.fidelity: Preserves ideal parallel plates, negligible fringing and approximately uniform field; vacuum or homogeneous, linear, isotropic, nondispersive dielectric with negligible losses; fixed dielectric properties and plate geometry. References (8-38), (8-43) and |V|=Ed are unchanged.
units.readability: The setup, complete list of material restrictions and substitution instruction are clear. The continuation after the semicolon retains the fixed-properties condition.

units.fidelity: Entire capacitor-energy equality chain, E_P, C, V, epsilon_0, epsilon, S, d, powers and factors are byte-identical; equation identifier (8-44) is preserved.
units.readability: The displayed equality remains directly connected to the preceding substitution.

units.fidelity: Retains the ideal-model limitation and field volume Sd; explicitly divides total stored energy in (8-44) by volume to obtain energy per unit volume.
units.readability: Energy density is defined plainly, without reversing the division.

units.fidelity: The full omega=epsilon_0 epsilon E^2/2 expression and identifier (8-45) are byte-identical.
units.readability: The formula follows its energy-density definition without added terminology.

units.fidelity: Retains the original textbook's additional electrostatic unit system and presents the next expression as the same relationship in that system.
units.readability: The unit-system change is explicit; no suggestion that the two formulas use identical units.

units.fidelity: The full omega=epsilon E^2/(8 pi) expression and identifier (8-46) are byte-identical.
units.readability: The formula remains attached to the stated electrostatic system of units.

units.fidelity: Retains pointwise use in nonuniform electrostatic fields and the vacuum/linear/isotropic/nondispersive/negligible-loss restrictions. Alternating electric-field energy uses instantaneous field strength under the same conditions. Magnetic energy must be counted separately; no unrestricted application to dispersive, nonlinear or significantly lossy media is asserted.
units.readability: The electric-field part and total electromagnetic energy are clearly distinguished. Both pieces of the semicolon-split warning were reviewed together; the last paragraph preserves the exclusions.

units.segment: From '1. The effective area' through 'slab is thinner than the distance between the plates.'
units.fidelity: Retains S, l, d, parallel insertion and Figure 160. Preserves initial net neutrality, electrical floating, no ground/supply/plate contact, full overlap coverage, vacuum gaps, negligible fringing and thickness below plate spacing.
units.readability: The requested capacitance and all model assumptions are explicit; slab is a clear English term for the inserted metal plate.

units.segment: From 'Solution: At electrostatic equilibrium' through the displayed total capacitance.
units.fidelity: Retains zero internal field, equal/opposite induced charges and zero net slab charge, two series vacuum-gap capacitors, x definition and positive gaps. Both C_1 and C_2 formulas, reciprocal sum and C=epsilon_0 S/(l-d) are unchanged. The already-approved C_1 source-bound correction is retained, not newly inferred.
units.readability: Every solution step and the role of each gap are present; no sign or variable ambiguity introduced.

units.segment: From 'Under these conditions' to the end.
units.fidelity: Retains conditional independence from slab position, thickness dependence, d->0 limit, and the explicit warning that a finite thin slab does not leave capacitance exactly unchanged.
units.readability: The ideal zero-thickness limit cannot reasonably be confused with a claim about every finite slab.

units.segment: From '2. Two capacitors' through 'decayed to a steady state.'
units.fidelity: Preserves capacitances 1 and 2 microfarads, initial voltages 300 and 150 volts, like-polarity connections and final-potential-difference request. Both supplies are disconnected, conductor combinations exchange no external charge, capacitances are voltage-independent, wire capacitance is neglected and real transients must decay.
units.readability: Correct singular/plural units and explicit steady-state wording; no connection-polarity reversal.

units.fidelity: All four before/after charge relations, magnitudes, primed symbols, like-sign charge-conservation relation and capacitance-weighted common voltage are retained. The final result is 200 volts, exactly as in the approved current Chinese.
units.readability: Charge magnitude is used consistently and the weighted-average derivation is complete.

units.segment: From 'This result follows from conservation of charge' to the end.
units.fidelity: Retains charge versus stored-field-energy distinction, transient current, lower final field storage, heat/radiation channels, conservation of total energy and the prohibition on assuming automatic settling without dissipation or radiation.
units.readability: The stored-energy qualification is clear and does not imply a failure of total energy conservation.

units.fidelity: Figure 160 in the English prompt denotes the same fig-160 identity and inserted-slab context as the current Chinese prompt. Manifest entry, source labels and asset references are unchanged.
units.readability: Figure 160 is an unambiguous English reference.
units.limitation: Artwork, labels within artwork and geometry are reused on the supplied approval basis; no image was opened.

captionAssessment.finding: There are no kind=cap prose objects and no figcap text nodes in either inspected native HTML artifact. Figure 160 is explicitly named in English in the current solved prompt. Its native figure ARIA label remains the source identity '图160'; it is not a newly authored English caption.

boundaries.assessment: The two current English adjacent-paragraph anchors preserve the approved transitions from total energy to energy density, and from electrostatic applicability to alternating electric-field storage. This is text continuity review, not layout approval.

reusedEvidence.approvalBasis: Caller explicitly authorizes reuse of unchanged approved Chinese source/science/figure evidence; prepared.json binds the approved current Chinese files.
reusedEvidence.historicalEntities: Empty current arrays remain empty; no names, source_term declarations or identity substitutions were introduced.
limitations: Only the figure review JSON metadata was read. Source image, FigureSpec geometry, render assets, SVG and image bytes were not opened or independently rehashed.
Media hashes inside prepared/review records are reused declared bindings, not fresh visual or byte-level certification by this reviewer.
Raw source pages/PDF and historical scan fidelity were not revisited. Their embedded source snapshots, source_text and erratum metadata were compared for unchanged retention only.
Native success and any earlier display failure/recovery are not English text approval. The native HTML was read only for textual caption/reference assessment, never rendered.
Parent retains responsibility for native execution, desktop/mobile display, pixel evidence, accessibility, retention and publication.
